messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up: Hosted Stream Gateway is GA and we're publishing a short policy update about telemetry & retention for gateway traffic. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/stream-gateway-ga/policy — please review if you own SDKs, billing notices, or customer comms.

mohit: Thanks. What changed in the policy?

elaine: Two main items: 1) telemetry sampling for streaming payloads defaults to 1% for new orgs (opt-out in Console), 2) short-lived aggregation logs (30d) enabled for route-level cost analysis. Were keeping raw customer input out of long-term logs by default.

policy-bot: policy-bot: Summary: telemetry_sample_rate=0.01 for new orgs, retention_aggregation=30d, raw_input_retention=72h unless customer opts in. See docs for API-level opt-out.

kevin: Ops note: nothing to change in auth/keys. If your customers need to opt-out programmatically we added a per-org flag: "gateway_telemetry": "off" in the Org API. Contact me if you need canary keys to test behavior.

sophie: Do we need to notify customers proactively? SLA implications?

elaine: Were sending a short console banner to org admins for 7 days and an email digest to paid accounts. No SLA changes; observability for SLOs remains via aggregated metrics. Individual request tracing will respect the org's telemetry setting.

mohit: Example of the Org API snippet?

elaine: Paste: 
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/{org_id} \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDFW_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"gateway_telemetry":"off"}'
```

policy-bot: policy-bot: Compliance note: customers in regulated regions (EU/UK) default to telemetry off; console will show a migration checkbox if they want to enable.

kevin: Alerting update: we added a "gateway-telemetry-rate" metric to infra dashboards so SRE can monitor sampling rates. Also updated runbook in Confluence.

sophie: I'll draft the customer FAQ and include how to opt-out + effect on debugging. Assigning to @sophie for FAQ and @kevin for runbook.

elaine: TL;DR: Stream Gateway GA + telemetry/retention policy published. New orgs default to 1% sampling, raw inputs kept 72h, aggregation logs 30d, opt-out via Org API or Console. Ping policy or ops with questions. :email:
